# Zuhause am Bach - Wachau

Official website: https://www.zuhauseambach-wachau.at/
Location: Aggsbach Markt, Wachau, Lower Austria, Austria
Accommodation: one private double room (Gartenzimmer), maximum 2 guests.
Key amenities: free Wi-Fi, free parking, secure bicycle storage, e-bike charging, breakfast on request, ski storage, drying room heated on request.
Winter focus: Jauerling skiing, floodlit skiing, Wachau winter stays, business travellers Monday-Thursday.
Direct booking: https://www.zuhauseambach-wachau.at/#requestForm
